domain: Healthcare Delivery & Health Economics (payment, claims and health plan analytics)

distractor_reasons.hospice_quality_measures_2026.xlsx: the provider numbers' 2025 and 2026 hospice quality reporting measures (care index, visits in the last days of life, assessments, family survey); quality scores enter neither the aggregate cap nor the inpatient cap, so no figure reads them
distractor_reasons.fy2027_operating_budget.xlsx: the 2027 operating budget's census, admissions and revenue by program; a plan for the next year, while the FY2026 cap counts the days beneficiaries did and will receive

sources.constructed: every file is constructed for this task by its generator (task482/generator); Wendleglen Hospice & Palliative Care, Fallowmere Hospice, their programs and places, their staff, the beneficiaries, identifiers, provider numbers and every record and number in the files are fictional
sources.public_specifications: the FY2026 hospice payment rates, labor shares and aggregate cap amount are those of the FY2026 Medicare hospice payment rule (CMS-1835-F, 90 FR 37404, 5 August 2025); the proportional method and the inpatient limit follow 42 CFR 418.309 and 418.302(f); the claim and remittance fields follow the institutional claim's type of bill, revenue code and HCPCS conventions and the 835 remittance's CLP and PLB records with claim adjustment reason code 253 for sequestration; the census register's discharge statuses are UB-04 patient status codes; diagnosis codes are ICD-10-CM
sources.licence: CC0 1.0 (constructed data); the public rule figures are US government works
